title: Malicious code in cobbleload (PyPI)
description: The cobbleload package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated campaign involving multiple loader packages designed to download and execute remote malicious scripts. Although the package itself does not contain the payload, its functionality enables execution of potentially harmful code from external URLs. This campaign is identified as malicious with intent similar to infostealers.
aiSummary: The cobbleload package (version 0.1.0) is involved in a malicious campaign that uses loader packages to execute code fetched from remote URLs. These packages do not embed the malicious payload directly but serve as delivery mechanisms for executing external malicious scripts. The campaign is coordinated and aims to provide multiple deceptive methods to load malicious code, indicating clear malicious intent.
aiImpact: The package enables execution of remote malicious scripts, which can lead to compromise of systems where it is installed. This capability can be abused to run arbitrary code, potentially leading to data theft, system manipulation, or further malware deployment. No direct payload is included in the package itself, but the risk arises from its ability to fetch and execute harmful code remotely.
